analyzed: tat idānīm ucyate vyavahāraḥ ca atra vādi prativādinoḥ itaretara aśana uddhārāya vṛttiḥ ucyate atha vā ṛṇa ādāna ādayaḥ padārthāḥ eva vipratipatti viṣayāḥ santaḥ vicāra gocara samartha tayā kartavyāḥ iti didṛkṣuḥ iti uktvā paśyet iti  sāmānādhikaraṇyam SNNe punar  ca  pratyavamarśaḥ teṣām adyam SNNeGd ṛṇa ādānam SNNe iti  tān padārthān vicārayet iti  saṃbandhaḥ vakṣyamāṇa adhikṛta puruṣa dhiṣṭhitaḥ SNPaM pradeśaḥ sa

original: atrocyate | brāhmaṇaviśeṣaṇam evaitat | te hy amantrajñā[6] bhūtvā nirapekṣam avadhārayantaḥ syuḥ | anyathā rājño 'nartham āvaheyuḥ | tathā hi mahāmatyāśritaḥ kaścij janapadena vyavaharan sahasā jito yadi na daṇḍyate dhanaṃ vāvaṣṭabhya na dāpyate, tadā samatvena vyavahāradarśanaṃ na kṛtaṃ syāt, pakṣapātam aśaktiṃ vāsya janapadā manyeran | atha daṇḍyate, mahāmātyakṣobhād api prakṛtivikṛtaṃ syāt | mantrajñās tu santaḥ saṃśayitāro yadi nirṇetavyasya kenacid apadeśena prasaṅgarodhaṃ kṛtvā rahasi rājānaṃ paribodhayanti "anayor vivādinor ayaṃ jīyate 'yaṃ jayatīti, vyavahāras tv asmābhir na tadānīm eva nirṇīta iti svāmī pramāṇam" | tatra rājaivaṃ viditvā mahāmātyam ādeśayati "tvadīyo manuṣyo jīyate, mama hanir mā bhūd iti saṃprati nirṇayo 'vadhīritaḥ | tvam eva tathā kuru yathaiṣa manuṣyaḥ saṃdhīyate, bādhāsya vyapanīyate" | te mantriṇo vādeyavākyā manuṣyāṇāṃ sarveṣām anarthyāṃ ca pravṛttiṃ pratibadhnanti |
analyzed: atrā ucyate brāhmaṇa viśeṣaṇam eva etat te hi amantrajñāḥ bhūtvā nirapekṣam avadhārayantaḥ syuḥ anyathā rājñaḥ nartham āvaheyuḥ tathā hi mahāmati āśritaḥ kaścid janapadena vyavaharan sahasā jitaḥ yadi na daṇḍyate dhanam vā avaṣṭabhya na dāpyate tadā sama tvena vyavahāra darśanam na kṛtam syāt pakṣapātam aśaktim vā asya janapadāḥ manyeran atha daṇḍyate mahā amātya kṣobhāt api prakṛti vikṛtam syāt mantra jñāḥ tu santaḥ saṃś

original: pāṇim udyamyeti | uttarapāṇim[12] uddhṛtyotthānaṃ kṛtvety arthaḥ | sūtrakṛto 'yaṃ vyatikramaḥ[13] sarvadā vihitatvād vyasanopavyānam etat | tenāyam arthaḥ: hasta utkṣeptavyaḥ, na punaḥ samīpavartini saṃlagnaḥ kartavyaḥ | praśnaniṣedhāvasare ca tenābhinetavyam, na tu pravyāṇādinā | anena vyavahāradarśanena tātparyaṃ khyāpitaṃ bhavati | prāyeṇa hi puruṣāḥ[14] kāryeṣu prayatnavanto hastam udyacchanti | yathāsukhopaviṣṭaṃ vrajati kartāraṃ tataś ca parijane tad etad rājā cittaṃ[15] na dadāti sabhyair nirbhayair vayaṃ jitā iti | pāṇigrahaṇaṃ bāhūpalakṣaṇārtham | kevalasya hi hastasya yāvad vyavahāradarśanaṃ vyāpāraṇaṃ pīḍākaram | na cāyam adṛṣṭārtha upadeśaḥ |
analyzed: pāṇim udyamya iti uttara pāṇim uddhṛtya utthānam kṛtvā iti arthaḥ sūtra kṛtaḥ yam vyatikramaḥ sarvadā vihita tvāt vyasana upavyānam etat tena ayam arthaḥ hastaḥ utkṣeptavyaḥ na punar samīpa vartini saṃlagnaḥ kartavyaḥ praśna niṣedha avasare ca tena abhinetavyam na tu pravyāṇa ādinā anena vyavahāra darśanena tātparyam khyāpitam bhavati prāyeṇa hi puruṣāḥ kāryeṣu prayatnavantaḥ hastam udyacchanti yathāsukha upaviṣṭam vrajati kartāram tatas

original: vinītaveṣābharaṇa iti | pūrvaśloke bāhyābhyantarendriyaviṣayāvadhānārtho 'bhihitaḥ | ayaṃ tāval lokānāṃ[16] śālīnatayā sukhopasarpaṇārthaḥ[17] | uddhataveṣe[18] hi rajani[19] tathāvidhānām apratipattiḥ syāt | ata uddhataveṣābharaṇaṃ[20] na kathaṃcit syāt[21] | veṣaḥ[22] keśavasanavinyāsādiviśeṣaḥ | ābharaṇaṃ karṇikādi | tatra uddhataveṣa[23] ūrdhvavastro javanaraktāmbaradhāritetyādi | uddhatābharaṇo[24] dīptimadbahuratnālaṃkāro bahuhāraś[25] ca | sa hy āditya iva durnirīkṣyaḥ sāmānyajanānāṃ viśeṣato 'bhiyuktānām | paśyed iti sabhāpraveśasya prayojanam āha | paśyed vicakṣaṇaḥ |
analyzed: vinīta veṣa ābharaṇaḥ iti pūrva śloke bāhya ābhyantara indriya viṣaya avadhāna arthaḥ bhihitaḥ ayam tāvat lokānām śālīna tayā sukha upasarpaṇa arthaḥ uddhata veṣe hi rajani 19 tathāvidhānām apratipattiḥ syāt atas uddhata veṣa ābharaṇam na kathaṃcid syāt veṣaḥ keśa vasana vinyāsa ādi viśeṣaḥ ābharaṇam karṇikā ādi tatra uddhata veṣaḥ ūrdhva vastraḥ javana rakta ambara dhārita ityādi uddhata ābharaṇaḥ dīptimat bahu ratna alaṃkār

original: ayaṃ ca rājño darśanāpadeśo daṇḍapraṇayane yathāsthānārthapratipādanaparyanto bhaviṣyati | tātparyaṃ[26] tasyaiva rakṣādhikāraḥ prayuktaḥ syāt | īdṛśasya ca darśanasyānyeṣām asaṃbhāvanād anadhikāraḥ | sarveṣāṃ saṃśayacchedamātraphalaṃ[27] tu vyavahāradarśanaṃ prāyaścittopadeśavad viduṣo brāhmaṇasyāsty eva | uktaṃ hi "dharmasaṃkaṭeṣu brūyāt" iti | tathaikavargyāṇāṃ vāṇijyakarṣakapaśupālaprabhṛtīnāṃ svavargasāmayikārthavipratipattāv anyasyāṃ votkṛṣṭanirṇayād bhūtir[28] iti tathāvidhavyavahāradarśane niyogaḥ | tathā hi paṭhitam |

original: yad api "likhitaṃ likhitena" iti naiṣā paribhāṣā vastusāmarthyāyātām avagatiṃ bādhituṃ śaknoti | dṛśyante hi dhanikahastagatalekhyaṃ[58] krameṇa saṃśodhayanto na ca pṛṣṭhe saṃśodhitaṃ dhanam abhilikhanti: "adya tāvad idaṃ dattam, prātar anyad ānīyaikīkṛtyopary āropayiṣyāmi, sarvaṃ vā katipayair ahobhiḥ saṃśodhya lekhyaṃ pāṭayiṣyāmi" iti | nānyavastuto saṃbandhaḥ[59] | dhanikena coparuddhasyāsaṃbhavaty aṃśamūlalābhadhane[60] saṃśuddhibhāgamātre dīyamāne kuta ayaṃ[61] tat prabhavati "na dadāti yāvat pratilekhyaṃ na dattam" iti | yadi caiṣā paribhāṣā "likhitaṃ likhitenaiva" iti tadā balopadhikṛtatvaṃ[62] kathaṃ vicāryatām | na hi tatra lekhyāntarasaṃbhavaḥ | tena yathātra saty eva lekhye tanniścayārthaṃ pramāṇāntaraṃ[63] vyāpāryate tadvad anyatrāpi vyāpāraṇīyam | yathā kaścid āvedayet: "asya[64] prayayaṃ gatvā lekhyaṃ mayā kṛtam anenoktaḥ sadyaḥ puṇyāhakāraṇam[65] imāṃ ca dhanamātrāṃ gṛhāṇa,[66] śvas te sarvaṃ dātāsmīty[67] uktvā saiva dhanamātrā dattā pariśiṣṭaṃ na dattam" iti, tadāsty eva sādhakāntaravyāpāraṇāvasaraḥ[68] | tatra yady adhamarṇasyāsmin prakāre sākṣiṇaḥ santi tadābhihite lekhya ābhāsīkṛte[69] śvodānam uttamarṇena sādhanīyam | atha tayor api rahasi paribhāṣeyam abhūt tadā daivyāḥ kriyāyā avasaraḥ | atha tu tasyām api vyabhicaritvād anāśvāsaḥ satyaśapathena vyavasthā kāryā |
analyzed: yat api likhitam likhitena iti na eṣā paribhāṣā vastu sāmarthya āyātām avagatim bādhitum śaknoti dṛśyante hi dhanika hasta gata lekhyam krameṇa saṃśodhayantaḥ na ca pṛṣṭhe saṃśodhitam dhanam abhilikhanti adya tāvat idam dattam prātar anyat ānīya ekīkṛtya upari āropayiṣyāmi sarvam vā katipayaiḥ ahobhiḥ saṃśodhya lekhyam pāṭayiṣyāmi iti na anya vastutaḥ saṃbandhaḥ dhanikena ca uparuddhasya asaṃbhavati aṃśa mūla lābha dhane saṃśuddhi bhā

original: anenārthena dvayaṃ vipratiṣidhyate | pratipannādhikāreṇa mithyādarśanaṃ na kartavyam anyena ca kriyamāṇaṃ nopekṣaṇīyam | tatrobhayathā doṣaḥ | abruvann anyena viparīte 'nuṣṭhīyamāne tūṣṇīm āsīno hastakṣepeṇa vā śāstranyāyaviruddhaṃ[91] bruvan kilbiṣī pāpabhāg bhavati | tena naiṣā pratyāśā kartavyā | dvitīyaḥ prāḍvivāko mithyā paśyati, sa eva yojyate[92], ahaṃ tūṣṇīṃbhūta udāsīnaḥ kim ity enasā yokṣya iti | sabhāpraveśaniṣedhena cātra vyavahāradarśanādhikārapratipattiḥ pratiṣidhyate | sabhā vā na praveṣṭavyeti | vyavahāradarśanādhikāro na pratipādanīya ity arthaḥ | pratipannaś cet samañjasaṃ vaktavyam | anena tv anadhikṛtasyāpi yadṛcchayā saṃnihitasya mithyāpaśyatsu sabhyeṣu viduṣas tūṇīṃbhāvaṃ necchanti | tathā ca "niyukto vāniyukto vā dharmajño vaktum arhati" | atha rājapuruṣaparyanuyoga āśaṅkyate kim ity anadhikṛto bravīti, tataś ca tatpradeśād apasartavyam | tad idam uktam: "durbalahiṃsāyāṃ cāvimocane[93] śaktaś cet" iti (GDh 21.19) || 8.13 ||
analyzed: anena arthena dvayam vipratiṣidhyate pratipanna adhikāreṇa mithyādarśanam na kartavyam anyena ca kriyamāṇam na upekṣaṇīyam tatra ubhayathā doṣaḥ abruvān anyena viparīte nuṣṭhīyamāne tūṣṇīm āsīnaḥ hasta kṣepeṇa vā śāstra nyāya viruddham bruvan kilbiṣī pāpa bhāj bhavati tena na eṣā pratyāśā kartavyā dvitīyaḥ prāḍvivākaḥ mithyā paśyati saḥ eva yojyate aham tūṣṇīṃbhūtaḥ udāsīnaḥ kim iti enasā yokṣye iti sabhā praveśa ni

original: na bhayād anyathādarśanaṃ kartavyam, yato dharmo vyatikrāntaḥ san hanti, no 'rthī[97] tatsahāyo rājā vā | tathā dharma eva pālitaḥ sarvato bhayam apanudati | nāpakartum arthyādayaḥ[98] kruddhāḥ śaknuvanti | tasmād evaṃjānatā,[99] "sukhaduḥkhe dharmādhīne" iti, dharmo na hantavyaḥ iti | yadi vayaṃ dharmaṃ hanmas tadā so 'smān sarpa iva roṣitaḥ pratihantīty ato dharmo hataḥ san mā asmān vadhīd ity ātmaparitrāṇārthaṃ dharmo rakṣitavyaḥ || 8.15 ||
analyzed: na bhayāt anyathā darśanam kartavyam yatas dharmaḥ vyatikrāntaḥ san hanti no rthī tad sahāyaḥ rājā vā tathā dharmaḥ eva pālitaḥ sarvatas bhayam apanudati na apakartum arthya ādayaḥ kruddhāḥ śaknuvanti tasmāt evaṃjānatā sukha duḥkhe dharma adhīne iti dharmaḥ na hantavyaḥ iti yadi vayam dharmam hanmaḥ tadā saḥ smān sarpaḥ iva roṣitaḥ pratihanti iti atas dharmaḥ hataḥ san mā asmān vadhīt iti ātma paritrāṇa artham dharmaḥ rakṣitavyaḥ

original: vṛṣalaśabdanirvacanena mithyādarśī nindyate | na jātivṛṣalo vṛṣalaḥ, kiṃ tarhi, yo vṛṣasya kāmavarṣiṇo dharmasya alaṃkurute | nivṛttivacanaḥ alaṃśabdaḥ | sa vṛṣala ity etam artham devāḥ pratipannāḥ | manuṣyās tu yadi jātiśabdam eva manyante, kāmaṃ manyantām, pramāṇatarās tu devāḥ | te cānena pravṛttinimittena vṛṣalaśabdaproyogaṃ manyante | devagrahaṇam arthavādaḥ | tasmāt "śrāddhakāle vṛṣalair na prāptavyam", "hantavyo vṛṣalaś cauraḥ," ityādyāsu kriyāsu mithyādarśī brāhmaṇa eva vṛṣalaśabdena grahītavya iti | ato vṛṣalatvaṃ mā prāpam iti dharmaṃ na lopayet, na nāśayed iti | vṛṣalatvādhyāropo nindā || 8.16 ||
analyzed: vṛṣala śabda nirvacanena mithyādarśī nindyate na jāti vṛṣalaḥ vṛṣalaḥ kim tarhi yaḥ vṛṣasya kāma varṣiṇaḥ dharmasya alaṃkurute nivṛtti vacanaḥ alaṃśabdaḥ sa vṛṣalaḥ iti etam artham devāḥ pratipannāḥ manuṣyāḥ tu yadi jāti śabdam eva manyante kāmam manyantām pramāṇatarāḥ tu devāḥ te ca anena pravṛtti nimittena vṛṣala śabda proyogam manyante deva grahaṇam artha vādaḥ tasmāt śrāddha kāle vṛṣalaiḥ na prāptavyam hant

original: bhayād dharmātikramo na kartavya ity etat "dharma eva hato hanti" ity anenopadiṣṭam, snehato na kartavya ity anenopadiśyate | yata ekaḥ suhṛd dharmaḥ, tatra sneho bhāvanīyaḥ | anyo 'pi manuṣyaḥ suhṛt[100] kāryam apekṣya jahāti jīvanam | yo 'pi syād atyantamitraṃ tasyāpi sauhārdam ā nidhanāt | dharmas tu mṛtam api puruṣam anveti | ato na suhṛdapekṣayā mithyādarśanam upekṣā vā[101] kartavyā |
analyzed: bhayāt dharma atikramaḥ na kartavyaḥ iti etat dharmaḥ eva hataḥ hanti iti anena upadiṣṭam snehataḥ na kartavyaḥ iti anena upadiśyate yatas ekaḥ suhṛd dharmaḥ tatra snehaḥ bhāvanīyaḥ manuṣyaḥ suhṛd kāryam apekṣya jahāti jīvanam syāt atyanta mitram tasya api sauhārdam nidhanāt dharmaḥ tu mṛtam api puruṣam anveti atas na suhṛd apekṣayā mithyā darśanam upekṣā vā kartavyā

original: uktaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha dharmanirṇayaṃ kuryāt, mantribhiś ca mantrajñaiḥ | tatra mantriṇāṃ jāter aviśeṣitatvāc chūdrā api sabhāṃ praviṣṭā mantritvād anujñātavyavahāranirṇayās tadratā dharmavyavasthāṃ kathaṃcit saṃskṛtabuddhayo brūyuḥ | na ca sarvatra vyavahāre smṛtiśāstraparijñānam upayujyate, yena tadabhāvād arthaluptatvād anarthakaḥ śūdrapratiṣedha āśaṅkyeta | tathā hi jayaparājayakāraṇāni laukikapramāṇavedyāny eva sākṣyādīni, ayaṃ sākṣī dhārmiko na caitasya kenacit saṃbandhena saṃbandhī | ayaṃ tv asākṣy asakṛd dṛṣṭavyabhicāratvād ity evamādi śakyate vyutpannabuddhinā svayam utprekṣituṃ na smṛtiśāstraikagocaraḥ[103] | ataḥ prāptasya pratiṣedho 'yaṃ | na ca mantritve purohitavaj jātiniyamaḥ | tathā hi "taiḥ sārdhaṃ cintayet" (MDh 7.56) ity uktvā tato brāhmaṇena saha cintayed iti (MDh 7.58) | tenāyam artho yady api kathaṃcic chūdro nyāyaleśāt samadhigacchet tathāpi rājādhikaraṇe vivadato mantrī nigrahādhikṛto vā na kiṃcit prabrūyāt | pūrvaślokārdhaḥ pratiṣedhaśeṣatayā[104] vyākhyeyaḥ | na hi jātimātropajīvino vaiduṣyādiguṇarahitasya dharmapravaktṛtvaniyogaḥ śakyo vaktuṃ tasyaiva rūpaparīkṣāyāṃ "tasmād viṣaṃ bhakṣaya mā cāsya gṛhe bhuṅkthā" itivat pratiṣedhaśeṣabhūtam idam anujñānaṃ na punar anujñānam eva | ata eva kāmam ity āha | kāmaśabdaprayoge hi vidhitvaṃ vyāhanyate |
analyzed: uktam brāhmaṇaiḥ saha dharma nirṇayam kuryāt mantribhiḥ ca mantrajñaiḥ tatra mantriṇām jāteḥ a viśeṣita tvāt śūdrāḥ api sabhām praviṣṭāḥ mantri tvāt anujñāta vyavahāra nirṇayāḥ tad ratāḥ dharma vyavasthām kathaṃcid saṃskṛta buddhayaḥ brūyuḥ na ca sarvatra vyavahāre smṛti śāstra parijñānam upayujyate yena tad abhāvāt artha lupta tvāt anarthakaḥ śūdra pratiṣedhaḥ āśaṅkyeta tathā hi jaya parājaya kāraṇāni laukika pramāṇa

original: anye tu bruvate | brāhmaṇasya pravaktṛtvavidhānāt tadā niyojyo vidvān syād brāhmaṇa iti kṣatriyādayas trayo 'pi varṇā niṣiddhās tatreha punaḥ śūdrapratiṣedho vidvadbrāhmaṇābhāve kṣatriyavaiśayor abhyanujñānārtha iti | śeṣaṃ samānam |

original: ayam api pūrvavad arthavāda eva | prakaraṇāc ca śūdrabhūyiṣṭhatā vivādanirṇaye tu[105] śūdraviṣayā draṣṭavyā | yatra śūdrā bhūyāṃso vivādanirṇayakārās tad rāṣṭram āśu vinaśyati durbhikṣavyādhipīḍābhiḥ | rāṣṭranāśe ca rāṣṭrapater nāśa ity uktaṃ bhavati | nāstikākrāntam iti dṛṣṭāntaḥ | yathā nāstikaiḥ paralokāpavādibhir lokāyatikādyair ākrāntam adhiṣṭhitam ataś ca

original: āptā avisaṃvādakā yathādṛṣṭārthavādinaḥ yeṣāṃ loko vipralambhakatvaṃ na saṃbhāvayati, dharmānuṣṭhānaparā ye khyātāḥ | sarvadharmavidaḥ śrautaṃ smārtam ācāranirūḍhaṃ ca sarvaṃ dharmam — iha narakaḥ phalam iha svarga ity evaṃ niravaśeṣam — jānanti te hy anṛtābhidhāne narakaṃ paśyanto bibhyati | alubdhā udārasatvā na svalpaṃ dhanaṃ bahu manyante | ekaikasya samastāni darvāṇi viśeṣaṇāni, sākṣikriyāyāṃ guṇabhūtatvād guṇe ca sāhityasya vivakṣitatvāt | sarveṣu varṇeṣv iti | sarvakāryeṣu[247] na jātiniyamo 'stīty uktaṃ bhavati | yat punar jātivyavasthāvacanaṃ tad upariṣṭād vakṣyāmaḥ | tad etad uktaṃ bhavati | sarvaiḥ kāryibhiḥ sarve varṇā yathāsaṃbhavaṃ sākṣiṇaḥ kartavyāḥ | kāryeṣu ṛṇādānādiṣu | yathoktalakṣaṇāt[248] viparītāṃs tu varjayet | yady api viśiṣṭeṣv abhihiteṣu tadviparītānāṃ prasaṅga eva nāsti tathāpi laukiko 'yaṃ paryudāsaḥ | prāyeṇa hi laukikā anyaṃ vidhāyānyaṃ[249] tadviparītaṃ niṣedhayanti | tathā ca bhavanti vaktāraḥ — "kriyā hi dravyaṃ vinayati nādravyam" iti | kiṃ cāvisaṃvādakatvam[250] iha pradhānaṃ sākṣilakṣaṇaṃ tac ca na vidhimukhena śakyāvasānam, kiṃ tu visaṃvādakaraṇābhāvamukhena | na hy avisaṃvādakatvaṃ pratyakṣadṛśyam | tad dhi yathārthābhidhānam | śrotragrāhye ca vastuni kutaḥ pratyakṣo yathārthaniścayaḥ | pratyakṣatve hi naiva sākṣyavagamo 'nviṣyate | na ca sarvatra parokṣe vastuni śabdāvagamye pramāṇāntarasaṃvādasaṃbhavaḥ | tasmād yāni bhūyastvena mithyābhidhānakaraṇatayā dṛṣṭāni tadabhāvaniścayenāvisaṃvādakatvam[251] anumīyate[252] | atas tatpradarśanārtho 'yam upakramo viparītāṃs tu varjayed iti || 8.63 ||
